message:
`innerHTML` replaces the content of this

, which has children too.
help: Remove the children, or put the markup in an element of its own beside them: `<div innerHTML={markup} />`.

message: <hr> is a void element: it holds no content for `innerHTML` to set.
help: Put the markup in an element that holds content, such as a <div> or a <span>.

message: The content of <textarea> is text, which the targets set apart from `innerHTML`.
help: A <textarea>'s text is its value: bind it with `v-model`.
